meta.title: Balamentum – What should you work on next?
meta.description: Balamentum uses your task dependencies and life areas to work out which task matters most right now. Sign in with Google and get going.

hero.title: What should you work on next?
hero.lead: Balamentum answers exactly that. It weighs dependencies and your life areas to find the task that pays off most right now. You get things done instead of sorting lists.
hero.ctaNote: Free. No credit card. Sign in with your Google account.
hero.screenshotAlt: Balamentum dashboard showing the next task and the life balance

items.title: Sign in with Google
items.text: One click. No form, no password.

items.title: Add your tasks
items.text: Type or speak them. Link dependencies and life areas whenever you like.

items.title: Do the next task
items.text: The dashboard shows what matters now and how balanced your week is.

items.title: One next task, not an endless list
items.text: The app shows the most valuable task whose prerequisites are already done. That is your answer to “what now?”.

items.title: Life balance drives priority
items.text: Body, relationships, meaning, mental health, impact: you weight your pillars, and the weights feed straight into every priority.

items.title: Dependencies that count
items.text: Tasks build on each other. Balamentum adds up value and effort along the whole chain and detects cycles.

items.title: Plan together
items.text: Invite family or team to a group by link and hand tasks to each other.

items.title: AI and voice input
items.text: Capture tasks by voice. The AI suggests matching pillars and polishes titles and descriptions, with your own provider if you prefer.

items.title: Open and always at hand
items.text: Installable on phone and desktop, with push reminders, location reminders and an MCP interface for your AI assistants.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.lead: Start for free. Need more? Switch plans in the app at any time.
pricing.discounts: Pay quarterly and save 10 %, pay yearly and save 20 %. All prices are final; no VAT is charged under § 19 UStG (German small business rule).
pricing.basics: Tasks, series, checklists, deadlines, points and balance analysis

features.ai_assist: AI help: pillar advisor and copy editing

items.a: The Free plan costs nothing and has no limit on the number of tasks. Pro, Max and Ultimate unlock groups, AI help and interfaces.

items.q: What data does the app get from Google?
items.a: Only your name, email address and profile picture. You don't need a separate password.

items.q: How do I cancel a plan?
items.a: In the app under Settings. Billing runs through PayPal, and you can switch or cancel at any time.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Balamentum is built for one-handed use and can be installed as an app on your home screen.
The interface follows WCAG 2.2 and BITV 2.0 and is built on the tested KoliBri components.

final.title: Your next task is waiting
final.text: Sign in, add your first task, get going.
